node.statement: For X=U^dagger, one has X^dagger=U and X^dagger bold-dot X=U bold-dot U^dagger, whose defect is at most 25*epsilon_r by node 1.2; moreover U is a right inverse of U^dagger because U^dagger bold-dot U=J. Thus U^dagger is an admissible approximate unitary input.
